prompt: Audit the security of the SMS codebase. I'm especially worried about whether teachers can accidentally see other schools' data, and whether the service role key is properly protected.

assertions.text: Report mentions NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY exposure risk (the key is named with NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix, making it potentially browser-accessible)
Report mentions school_id filter requirement with at least one concrete example of a query that is missing it or confirms all queries are properly scoped
Report covers AuthGuard and SchoolIdGuard — either confirming correct coverage or identifying specific gaps with file paths
Report addresses teacher role isolation (teachers should only see their own school's sections/subjects/grades)
Report includes at least 3 specific file paths (not just general observations)
Report uses severity levels (Critical/High/Medium/Low) or equivalent prioritization
Report mentions student portal JWT authentication security (separate from Supabase Auth)
